subject: Security intake: SOC2 / pen test / DPA — slot grid & bridge preference
messages:
From: Sara Bishop <sara.bishop@finovate.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Security intake: SOC2 / pen test / DPA review — request for walkthrough slots

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the intro call last week. We're ready to move to a formal walkthrough to confirm scope for SOC2 readiness, an upcoming vendor-led penetration test, and to sign off on the DPA redline. High-level asks:

- 60–90 minute walkthrough covering control mapping + evidence handoff
- 30–45 minute pen-test logistics call with AssureSec (vendor) to confirm scope, test windows, and blast radius
- DPA review + signature cadence (we prefer DocuSign)

We are on Eastern time. Can you confirm availability for any of these windows next week (all ET):
- Mon 11/23 10:00–12:00
- Wed 11/25 13:00–15:00
- Thu 11/26 09:00–11:00 (shorter block if needed)

I attached a short scope doc (finovate_scope_v1.pdf) — it has a proposed inventory and high-level compliance asks. Also: are you able to provide a short "evidence map" ahead of the walkthrough? That helps our internal auditors triage.

Bridge preference: Zoom is fine, but if you have a dedicated secure bridge (no public recording) we'd like to use it for the pen-test logistics call.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Sara Bishop
Security Program Manager
Finovate Inc.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bishop <sara.bishop@finovate.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC2 / pen test / DPA review — request for walkthrough slots

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the scope doc — useful context. We can do any of the windows you listed; to make scheduling straightforward I've attached a simple slot matrix (redwood_proposed_slots.csv) with our team's availability and recommended durations. Quick notes:

- We suggest a single 75-minute combined SOC2 + DPA walk (first 50 mins controls + evidence, last 25 mins DPA Qs). That reduces context switching for your team.
- Pen-test logistics call: we recommend a 30-min separate meeting with AssureSec and our SecOps lead (Karthik).
- For the pen-test call we'll use a private Meeting Room (no public recording). We'll send a bridge-invite.ics once the slot is locked.

Preferred (ET): Wed 11/25 13:00–14:15 as the combined walkthrough, and Wed 11/25 14:30–15:00 for pen-test logistics. If that works, I can send calendar invites and a pre-walkthrough checklist.

Also: can you confirm the pen vendor contact (cc'd above?) and whether you need a non-disclosure addendum for the evidence transfer?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Security Lead — Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Naomi / Sara — quick note from SecOps:

- Wed 11/25 13:00–14:15 ET works for us; we can have the SecOps engineer + product owner on the call.
- Pen-test logistics at 14:30 ET is fine, AssureSec can join remotely.
- Bridge: we'll use our private RedBridge instance (no recording) and share a dial-in + otp.

Action items:
1) Naomi — please send invites with RedBridge link and pre-walkthrough checklist.
2) Sara — please confirm AssureSec attendee email (I see penvendor@assuresec.com; if there's a person we can invite directly that helps).
3) Naomi / Jasmine — prepare a short evidence index (spreadsheet) and a mapping to SOC2 criteria; we'll circulate to Finovate 24 hours before the call.

Karthik
Sr. SecOps Engineer — Redwood Inference

Perfect — Wed 11/25 booked on our side. AssureSec will join as a named contact: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@assuresec.com>.

I signed the DPA redline (I routed it to our legal team) — sending a DocuSign envelope now: https://app.docusign.com/ENVELOPE/0a1b2c3d.

Next steps summary:
- Naomi to send calendar invites + RedBridge link + pre-walkthrough checklist (by EOD Monday)
- Redwood to circulate evidence index 24h before the call
- AssureSec (Marco) to join the 14:30 pen-test logistics slot

Thanks — looking forward.

Sara Bishop
Security Program Manager
Finovate Inc.
